name: gespan-desktop
description: A desktop GUI for your coding agents
author: vasanth

scripts.check: bun run test:host && bun run check:rust && bun run native:lint && bun run native:test:app
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test
scripts.native:test:dev: node --test scripts/dev-native.test.mjs scripts/bundle-native-macos.test.mjs scripts/cargo-workspaces.test.mjs scripts/native-dependencies.test.mjs scripts/native-release.test.mjs scripts/package-native.test.mjs
scripts.native:test: cargo test --locked -p gespan-tracker-client && cargo test --locked -p gespan-board-store && bun run native:test:app
scripts.native:test:app: cargo test --locked --manifest-path crates/gespan-gpui/Cargo.toml -p gespan-core --profile native-dev && cargo test --locked --manifest-path crates/gespan-gpui/Cargo.toml -p gespan-gpui --profile native-dev -- --test-threads=1 && cargo build --locked --manifest-path crates/gespan-gpui/Cargo.toml -p gespan-gpui --profile native-dev && cargo test --locked --manifest-path crates/gespan-gpui/Cargo.toml -p gespan-first-launch --profile native-dev
scripts.native:lint: bun run native:test:dev && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/gespan-gpui/Cargo.toml --all --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path crates/gespan-gpui/Cargo.toml -p gespan-core -p gespan-gpui -p gespan-first-launch --all-targets --profile native-dev -- -D warnings
scripts.native:check: bun run native:lint && bun run native:test
